concerns.text: FR-010 requires a clean finite‑time baseline for *every* window size T, but no task in tasks.md creates or stores such per‑window baselines. Existing tasks (T009) compute only a single asymptotic baseline.

SC-004 mandates measuring the total end‑to‑end pipeline runtime against a 45‑minute CI limit. The current tasks only benchmark before/after optimisation (T014) and do not verify the overall runtime, leaving the success criterion uncovered.
